title: NO OBJECTION CERTIFICATE
paragraphs: This is to certify that you have availed a loan facility bearing Loan Account Number {loanNo} from BlinkR Loan, a brand of RBI Registered NBFC: Dev-Aashish Capitals Private Limited.
